metadata.name: Evocative Language Master Library
metadata.description: The ultimate songwriting database. Combines concrete sensory imagery, modern vernacular, timeless American phrases, body language, physical details, and comprehensive sensory vocabulary.

sensory_details.description: Concrete sensory vocabulary for vivid songwriting - sounds, smells, textures, tastes, and temperatures
